description: Capability set for the share-detail window (ShareDetail.svelte: the QuickWindowSidePane rail beside a ShareMainPane or DmThreadPane main pane). Receives the event list via IPC after share_detail_window_ready (ready handshake); uses window.open() (Web API, no shell plugin needed) for the HQ Console link. Rail: list_channels, plus fetch_notification_history, get_activity_log and fetch_notifications (unread ids) through notificationFeedData. Share pane: toggle_reaction / fetch_reactions (messageScope 'share:{eventId}', messageId = eventId), set_watched_shares (registers the visible share eventIds with the SINGLE DM poll path so a 'reaction' wake re-fetches and emits message:reaction), open_messages_window (the 'Message the sharer' action deep-links Messages with a pending conversation target), and get_config + open_claude_code_link (share card 'Open in Claude'). DM pane: fetch_dm_thread, send_dm, toggle_reaction / fetch_reactions / set_active_conversation with a dm:{personUid} scope, list_syncable_workspaces + hq_pro_fetch (attachment companies and presigned previews), and open_desktop_alt_window (open a folder attachment in Files). All of these are app commands authorized by core:default. shell:allow-open is required because this window mounts the shared <DmThreadPane/> → <Conversation/> pane, which opens message links through @tauri-apps/plugin-shell open() and renders DM bodies through renderMessageBodyMarkdown; its markdown-link and autolink branches emit <a target="_blank"> anchors that tauri-plugin-shell's injected click listener intercepts by invoking plugin:shell|open with no .catch(), so without the grant the click is inert and the ACL denial surfaces as an uncatchable UnhandledRejection (Sentry HQ-DESKTOP-4F, whose grouping signature carries no window label). The plugin's default open scope (https?://, mailto:, tel:) already covers every scheme safeHref admits, so no plugins.shell scope block is added to tauri.conf.json.
